assertions.assertion: The denial was issued under CARC code CO-22.
The service at issue is CPT 93229.
CPT 93229 is mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring.
The clinical indication is documented in a clinical indication note.
The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and dizziness.
There is concern for paroxysmal supraventricular tachycardia.
Diagnosis code I47.1 applies to the case.
Diagnosis code R42 applies to the case.
The patient has a history of transient cerebral ischemic attacks.
Diagnosis code G45.9 applies to the case (transient cerebral ischemic attacks).
Prolonged ambulatory monitoring is indicated to correlate cardiac rhythm disturbances with the neurological symptoms and dizziness.
